messages:
jordan: Hey folks — I reorganized the kv-cache tests into pkg/kvcache/test/ so the allocator mocks are reusable across suites. I also extracted a tiny API shim into test/helpers to avoid duplication. PTAL when you have a sec. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2387

maya: Thanks for the heads-up. Quick thing: CI failed on TestKVRotation (linux). I dropped the failing log in the PR comments. That test looks timing-sensitive — can we add a retry instead of a blind sleep?

jordan: Good catch. I added a 3-attempt retry with 50ms backoff and a note describing why the retry exists. Also switched that test to use MockAllocator so it doesn't rely on wall-clock ordering as much.

sam: PTAL — left a couple of tiny nits inline. Prefer t.Run subtests for the different allocation scenarios and move the sleep values into a const block. Also, do we want this squashed? The reorg commits are a bit noisy.

jordan: I can squash. My plan: (1) reorg + helpers, (2) test fixes + flakiness guard. Squash into two commits if people want a cleaner history.

katie: If you squash, make sure the changelog line stays in the second commit (test fixes). Also rebase onto main — there was a proto change merged earlier today.

jordan: Rebased onto main and squashed into two commits per plan. Pushed and triggered CI rerun.

deploy-bot: CI passed on linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 :white_check_mark: (build/2387)

maya: LGTM, approving. :thumbsup:

sam: Approving as well, thanks for the cleanup. :eyes:

jordan: Thanks all — will merge once we have one more green. If CI flakes again I'll revert and follow up here.
